final: WITH u AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, s.instownpct AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT mix, AVG(own) AS base FROM u GROUP BY mix), o AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS overall FROM u) SELECT AVG(u.own) AS avg_own, AVG(u.own / b.base) AS avg_ratio, AVG(u.own - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM u JOIN b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN o WHERE u.own > o.overall
